name: Chef's Feast
source:
On a dark night after work, you walk home alone hungry. Upon noticing a nearby restaurant, your visit can be a heartwarming meal or your last one.

[From [url=https://a02nina.itch.io/chefs-feast]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
下班后的漆黑夜晚，饥肠辘辘的你独自走在回家的路上。当你注意到附近亮着灯的一家餐厅时，踏进店门的你迎来的既可能是一顿暖心美食，也可能是人生的最后一餐。

[摘自[url=https://a02nina.itch.io/chefs-feast]itch.io[/url]]
